newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan-Gulf Bank to open third West Bank branch.
newsitem.headline: Jordan-Gulf Bank to open third West Bank branch.

text.p: Jordan-Gulf Bank is expected to open its third branch in Palestinian self-rule areas this month, its general manager said on Monday.
"We expect to open our third branch in Ramallah this month," Charles Gress, general manager of Jordan-Gulf Bank, told Reuters.
The bank took over in 1993 licences for four West Bank branches from the dissolved Mashreq Bank.
Under Jordan's 1994 peace accord with Israel, Jordanian banks were allowed to re-open branches in the West Bank which were shut down after Israel's 1967 occupation of the territories.
The bank has already reactivated two of those licences, one in Nablus and Tulkaram.
Jordan-Gulf Bank, with a network of 30 branches across Jordan, aims to open a fourth West Bank branch in Hebron.
The bank's total balance sheet stood at 180 million dinars ($254 million) at end of December 1996, a rise of 5 percent from 1995.
